headline: Community Development Grant Funds Emerge as Housing Incentive Lever in New Law, Realtor.com® Report Finds
summary: A new report from Realtor.com® examines how the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act's Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) payout program could shape local housing policy, finding that the incentives are likely to be most consequential in smaller, post-industrial markets across the Midwest and Northeast, where CDBG funding represents a larger share of city budgets and new construction is relatively scarce.
